CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_packaging_rules (supplier_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,category VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,container VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,instructions VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL,inserts_json TEXT NOT NULL,require_photo TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,revision INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,updated_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY (supplier_id,category))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_packaging_signoffs (order_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,snapshot_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL,checks_json TEXT NOT NULL,checked_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,checked_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_sla_policies (supplier_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,accept_hours SMALLINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,production_hours SMALLINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,dispatch_hours SMALLINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,updated_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_job_deadlines (order_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,accept_by VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,production_by VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,dispatch_by VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,updated_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_messages (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,order_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,author_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,body VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL,attachment_id VARCHAR(64) NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX (order_id,created_at))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_notifications (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,supplier_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,order_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,kind VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,message VARCHAR(250) NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,read_at VARCHAR(40) NULL,INDEX (user_id,read_at,created_at),INDEX (supplier_id,created_at))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_shipping_events (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,order_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,supplier_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,event_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,notes VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL,created_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX (order_id,created_at))
